# polaris-mail-bridge (polaris-mail-local-lego)

Generated by `polaris-email setup bridge` on 2026-05-16T12:00:00Z from the
[polaris-email](https://github.com/vladzaharia/polaris-email) CLI version
`v0.0.0-test`. This directory is a self-contained mail-bridge
deployment — the image, compose file, env, secrets, and TOML config all
live here.

Mode: **local** &nbsp;·&nbsp; TLS source: **lego**
&nbsp;·&nbsp; Image: `ghcr.io/vladzaharia/polaris-mail-bridge:v0.0.0-test`

## Day-to-day

```sh
docker compose pull         # fetch the pinned image
docker compose up -d        # start
docker compose ps           # health
docker compose logs bridge  # tail
docker compose down         # stop
```

For Lego-managed TLS, activate the `lego` profile when running compose:

```sh
docker compose --profile lego up
```

## Re-running the wizard

`polaris-email setup bridge` will detect this directory and offer drift
remediation rather than re-prompting from scratch. To intentionally
re-register (e.g. after the bridge was deregistered server-side):

```sh
polaris-email setup bridge destroy --dir .
polaris-email setup bridge --dir .
```
